def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - np.minimum(item, bins)
    return remaining

algorithm: {We compute priority as the remaining capacity after adding the item, preferring bins where the item fits exactly or leaves the smallest positive remaining capacity, while heavily penalizing overflows.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    # Large negative penalty for overfull bins
    penalty = -1e9
    priority_scores = np.where(remaining >= 0, remaining, penalty)
    # Prefer smallest positive remaining capacity (closest fit)
    # Invert so smallest positive remaining gets highest priority
    max_rem = np.max(priority_scores[priority_scores >= 0])
    if max_rem > 0:
        priority_scores = np.where(priority_scores >= 0, max_rem - priority_scores, priority_scores)
    return priority_scores

algorithm: {The algorithm calculates priority by first assigning the highest score to bins where the item fits exactly, then to bins with remaining capacity closest to twice the item size (favoring bins that will have more balanced remaining capacity after placement), and finally to bins with the largest remaining capacity if no bin can accommodate the item exactly.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    exact_fit = (remaining == 0)
    fits = (remaining >= 0) & (~exact_fit)
    does_not_fit = (remaining < 0)
    
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    
    priority_scores[exact_fit] = np.inf
    priority_scores[fits] = -np.abs(remaining[fits] - item)
    priority_scores[does_not_fit] = bins[does_not_fit]
    
    return priority_scores
